full_grammar_candidates.grammar: Original entire message only: exact singular/plural header and count; one to three source/key rows; key-specific exact public hint; exact remaining-count suffix if count > 3. No trailing text. Source/key slots discarded.
full_grammar_candidates.conservative_bounds: 1..9999 total settings, opaque slots <=1024 UTF-8 bytes. Retain fixed MDM colon, enterprise comma-space, project /config.toml. A bounded_label truncation that loses required syntax is NOT a full shape match. No normalization or dynamic source/key output.

policy.matches: Complete original equality or bounded full grammar; no strip, lower, Unicode normalization, arbitrary text redaction or text hash. Embedded recognized anchors or concatenated templates become ambiguous. Control characters except required LF reject. Oversize invalid Unicode input remains unknown, never classify a truncated prefix.
policy.family: At most one constant hint from a long leading public anchor. Incomplete full-grammar candidates may yield only their family hint. Arbitrary dynamic error tails are NEVER treated as a complete template. A spoofed string can match; shape is NOT authenticated producer identity or root cause.
policy.privacy: No message text, dynamic slots, keys, paths, account strings, URLs, hashes, word sets, slot lengths or additional shape fingerprints in the projection. Existing v2 input-byte/truncation diagnostics remain unchanged; no additional text fingerprint.
policy.effect: Every item.error stays blocked with output null. No retry, model/provider fallback, new credentials, feature/config changes or permission expansion. Projection failure cannot replace primary notification rejection.
policy.ordinary_tasks: Collector defaults off. Runner independently verifies all fixed public task semantic fields via fingerprint, execution IDs, empty trace/deadline, exact model/version and both diagnostic collectors BEFORE subprocess or cache access.
policy.limitations: Non-exhaustive reviewed producer inventory. Nothing here proves the observed 144-byte unknown notification belongs to any listed producer. If the next authorized probe remains unknown or only an insufficient family hint, stop template-guess/build loops; user-local review of that one message needs a separately approved nonlogging mechanism. No human window in this patch.
